attributes.analyst_notes: The customer denied a $30.02 online purchase made from a proxy desktop device. The card has a history of online transactions in region 330.0, while this transaction originated from region 203.0. Prior confirmed fraud cases (AGENT-HHG-009, AGENT-HHG-008, AGENT-HHG-004) involved the same card and device, indicating a card‑not‑present fraud pattern. Multiple other cards share the same device, reinforcing shared‑device fraud risk. Based on multiple independent evidences, the fraud probability is high.

The cardholder C13171 reported an unauthorized $55.68 online purchase made from a proxy desktop device. The same card and device have been involved in multiple prior confirmed card‑not‑present fraud cases (AGENT-HHG-008, CC-5010, CC-4485, CC-0056). Combined with the customer denial and the proxy device, the fraud probability is high (0.92). The case is closed as fraud with the card blocked and a SAR filed.
